purpose: A Windows-only .NET Framework 4.8 solution: a pre-SDK Windows Forms app and classic ASP.NET MVC site with packages.config, a pre-SDK MSTest project, and an SDK-style net48 library. None of it builds in the audit's Linux containers (a pre-SDK project fails with MSB3644 there), so the solution is one component listed as needing Windows and blocked on this machine, with what its files say (net48, the pre-SDK format, three packages.config) and no level. Nothing runs, and the report never says it has no tests or a failing build, as it did when the solution was built as ordinary .NET.
